decision: whether patient-reported, access, communication, digital-service, and service-use evidence can be linked with aligned denominators and interpreted without causal, preference, quality, or ranking claims

source.publisher: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality

target.definition: AGE24X at least 18, PERWT24F greater than zero, and IPDIS24 at least one

measurement.domain_variance_rule: retain every sampled PSU with zero contribution outside the analytic domain

data_classes.public: official MEPS public-use person and event files
data_classes.public_derived: released linked person and event tables with sequential teaching IDs
data_classes.synthetic: accepted Module 03 invitation, response, Q21, Q22, Q23, mode, and item-missingness fields
data_classes.not_available: portal access, portal preference, local workflow, and real HCAHPS patient-level responses

permissions.module05_patient_voice_work: permitted after all linkage gates pass
